problem: Every date arrives before the date does
action: Morning. Chest-up on the dealer standing under the canopy holding his phone up in front of him in one hand, reading it. His face is relaxed and faintly pleased — the look of a man who has just been told something in good time rather than too late. His shoulders are down and easy.
lighting: Clean warm morning light on his face from camera left, soft shadow, bright airy background thrown out of focus.
camera: Chest-up, he fills the vertical frame, head in the upper third, phone entering the lower edge. Sharp on his face. 35mm.
detail: The phone screen is DARK and unreadable — no interface, no text, no glow, no logos. Same cream full-sleeve shirt with the sleeves rolled, same dark navy trousers, same watch.
feeling: Being told in time. The whole product in one facial expression.
motion: He reads, then nods once, very slightly. A slow push in. Nothing else moves, no cuts, no camera shake, nobody speaks.

voice_over.hi: हर तारीख़ की ख़बर, तारीख़ आने से पहले।
